disclaimer: Deadlines and amounts are as published in the source research dated 2026-10-25. Settlement terms change and claims are judged on the official site's rules, not this feed. entries.filingNote: Official search ONLY at claimit.ca.gov / sco.ca.gov (State Controller's Office), free forever. CA is NOT on MissingMoney.com — use unclaimed.org (NAUPA) for other states. Never pay a 'finder' — CA caps finder fees at 10% and you never need one.
entries.name: California unclaimed property
entries.payout: Varies — found claims commonly $50–$1,000+; simple single-owner cash claims pay in 30–60 days, complex claims up to 180 days
entries.proofRequired: Legal name variants + address history to search; to file: government ID, proof of address(es) matching the property, SSN proof
entries.whoFits: Anyone who may have dormant bank accounts, uncashed paychecks, insurance proceeds, utility/rental deposits, stocks/dividends, or safe-deposit proceeds in California (CA holds $12.3B+)

entries.filingNote: 3-year rule (IRC 6511). Refund can be held if 2024/2025 also unfiled, and offset against federal/state debts or child support.
entries.name: IRS unfiled refund — tax year 2023
entries.payout: Varies — withheld wages + refundable credits; e-file + direct deposit typically ~21 days after IRS acceptance
entries.proofRequired: File the 2023 return (W-2s/1099s); sign and file yourself or authorize e-filing
entries.whoFits: Anyone who had tax withheld or refundable credits (e.g. EITC) in 2023 but did not file a return

entries.name: IRS unfiled refund — tax year 2024
entries.payout: Varies — withheld wages + refundable credits; e-file + direct deposit typically ~21 days after IRS acceptance
entries.proofRequired: File the 2024 return (W-2s/1099s); sign and file yourself or authorize e-filing
entries.whoFits: Anyone who had tax withheld or refundable credits in 2024 but did not file a return

entries.filingNote: Included so the feed says so plainly: any site telling you to claim a 2022 IRS refund in late 2026 is selling false hope.
entries.name: IRS unfiled refund — tax year 2022
entries.payout: EXPIRED — the 2022 window closed Apr 15, 2026; the ~$1.2B / ~1.3M people / median ~$686 is gone
entries.whoFits: No one — this window is closed

entries.filingNote: Replacement-card deadline was Apr 8, 2026. Any site/video in Oct 2026 telling you to 'claim your MCTR' is selling false hope.
entries.name: California Middle Class Tax Refund (MCTR)
entries.payout: EXPIRED — debit-card balances expired Apr 30, 2026 and unspent funds were swept to the CA General Fund; they did NOT go to unclaimed property and cannot be recovered
entries.whoFits: No one — this program is over

entries.filingNote: No Treasury Hunt tool anymore — claim via FS Form 1048 through the Treasury.
entries.name: Matured U.S. savings bonds
entries.payout: Varies — $29B+ unredeemed; a $100 EE bond from 1986 ≈ $400; processing 8–13 weeks
entries.proofRequired: FS Form 1048 (lost/stolen/destroyed); signature must be certified/notarized
entries.whoFits: Anyone holding paper EE/I bonds that have matured (bonds stop earning at 30 years)

entries.filingNote: CA Civil Code 1950.5: landlord must return the deposit or an itemized statement within 21 calendar days of vacating. Small claims up to $12,500, no lawyer needed, if ignored.
entries.name: California rental security deposit
entries.payout: Deposit amount; bad-faith withholding can add up to 2x the deposit by court award. Total deposit is capped at 1 month's rent and 'nonrefundable' deposit fees are generally illegal in CA
entries.proofRequired: Lease, move-out date, and proof of the deposit amount; a written demand letter is the usual first step
entries.whoFits: Anyone who vacated a CA rental and never got their deposit back or an itemized statement

entries.filingNote: Search the PBGC unclaimed retirement benefits database and the National Registry of Unclaimed Retirement Benefits — both free.
entries.name: Unclaimed pensions / forgotten 401(k)s
entries.payout: Varies — recovered retirement wealth; a found 401(k) is a rollover, not spendable cash without tax/penalty
entries.proofRequired: Name + last-4 SSN to search the PBGC database; account details to claim
entries.whoFits: Anyone who left a job with a pension plan that terminated, or a forgotten 401(k)
